company.name: Force Corp. and AB Construction Group Inc.

items.label: WHD civil: Force Corp. and AB Construction Group Inc.
items.detail: Federal civil contempt litigation in D. Mass. enforcing a 2016 consent judgment over misclassifying construction workers as independent contractors; date is the announcement date. The $1.8 million, from court-ordered real estate sales and additional funds, is distributed to 478 workers as back wages and damages; the companies had earlier remitted $547,900 (not added) and officers Juliano Fernandes and Anderson dos Santos are left out. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-whd-2022-force-corp-ab-construction; listed under Amounts not counted).

excluded_amounts.defendant: Force Corp. and AB Construction Group Inc.
excluded_amounts.reason: From the row note (release read 2026-10-10): "the companies had earlier remitted $547,900 (not added)" under the same 2016 consent judgment. Counted: the $1.8 million distributed in 2022. Update 2026-10-11 (shared total): the $1.8 million came from court-ordered sales of property owned or used by the defendants' individual owner, his wife or a non-defendant entity, and 'additional funds from Fernandes'; the release does not say the two companies funded any part, so it is counted for no company (overlap group shared-whd-2022-force-corp-ab-construction, data/manual/shared-allocations.csv). Not counted: that $1.8 million plus the $547,900 the defendants had earlier remitted.
